measurement: JSON-RPC batch stickiness and silent toBlock clamping on the public Yominet RPC

batchProbe.method: per sample: H = eth_blockNumber (own request); A = eth_getLogs(World,[H-4,H]) (own request, the 0.6.x reconcile pattern); B = ONE batch [eth_blockNumber, eth_getLogs(World,[H-4,H]), eth_blockNumber]; reference = the same range re-read >= 30 s later from a backend whose head >= H+10, two agreeing reads (or, where the chain paused and no such reference formed in time, three agreeing post-hoc reads)
batchProbe.rule: chunk proven through min(to, batchHead1 - K); violations over all samples: K=0 -> 0, K=1 -> 0

streamPositions.note: txHash, componentId and entityId equal the eth_getLogs log at the same (blockNumber, logIndex)
